effectSummary.ko: 그림자 추격의 지속시간이 2초, 총 발동 상한이 2회 늘어납니다.
effectSummary.en: Shadow Pursuit lasts 2s longer and allows 2 additional total procs.

prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone HELLSCRIPT passive skill icon, matching painterly dark gothic fantasy game icons. Generate one original square PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. One isolated symbolic subject. Worn iron, aged leather, restrained sculptural chiaroscuro, crisp broad highlights, dark solid midtones, strong distinctive readable silhouette at 64 pixels. Entire subject including effects inside the central 72 percent, leave clear fully transparent margins. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, frame, medallion rim, panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard, matte, or tiny particles. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha. Output a transparent PNG. Identity (do not render text): Ranger passive Relentless Pursuit, 끝없는 추격. Effect: Shadow Pursuit lasts longer and permits two additional shadow echoes. Subject: a single worn hunter's boot with a violet shadow ribbon splitting into two broad ghostly trailing heel echoes. Compact diagonal silhouette, aged dark leather, muted silver heel armor and restrained violet edge light. A quiet enduring symbol of persistence and pursuit, no ground, footprint, person, bow, arrows, or scene.

visualReview.en: The leather boot and two violet echoes remain distinct from the hooded execution emblem.
visualReview.ko: 가죽 장화와 두 개의 보랏빛 잔상이 기존 두건 문양과 구별됩니다.

edgeReview.en: Inspected native image and 64px light/dark composites: no visible opaque matte, clipped core, or edge halo. Native pixels unchanged; low-alpha fringe warnings retained.
edgeReview.ko: 원본과 64px 밝은 배경·어두운 배경 비교에서 주요 형태의 잘림, 불투명 바탕, 눈에 띄는 테두리 번짐이 없습니다. 원본 픽셀은 변경하지 않았으며 낮은 알파 경계 경고는 보존했습니다.
